title: Facade — one call, many subsystems (Python)
description: A facade offers one simple function over several fiddly subsystems. Clients get simplicity; the subsystems stay untouched underneath.
how_it_works: The facade coordinates the subsystem checks and reduces them to one answer.
complexity: O(subsystems). Tuning: profile before optimizing; the notes above name the usual bottleneck to measure first.

test_cases.note: Determinism check: re-running the snippet reproduces the identical output.

pitfalls: Facades hide power — expose the subsystems too for advanced users.
use_cases: Startup checks, library APIs, onboarding flows.
